name: Jellyfin
description: Stream your movies, shows and music to your TV, phone and computer.

afterInstall.text: Click Open. Jellyfin starts a short setup: pick your language and create your Jellyfin user.
When asked to add a media library, choose the type (Movies, Shows, Music) and select the folder /media.
Put your files in the media folder listed under Data on this page. Jellyfin picks them up on its next library scan.
On a phone or TV, install the Jellyfin app and enter the address shown at the top of this page.
